script: Why would an NBA player miss a free throw on purpose? In this arena, if a player misses two straight free throws, every fan gets free chicken. So when Boban stepped to the line, he missed the first one by accident. But then he noticed the whole crowd was cheering for him to miss again. At that point, the Rockets were already out of playoff contention, so the shot didn't really matter. And because Boban is a man of the people, he intentionally missed the next free throw and it made the entire arena's night.
